{"query":"
  query Ppss(
    $countrycode: String!
    $languagecode: String!
    $productType: String!
  ) {
    PPSS(
      countrycode: $countrycode
      languagecode: $languagecode
      productType: $productType
    ) {
      fundid
      cntrycode
      webprdcttaxonomy
      fundname
      assetclass
      basecurrcode
      fundcatg
      invmangr
      invstmntcatg
      invvehcile
      region
      invstmntgroup
      etftype
      strategy
      methodology
      fundfamily
      sfdrcategory
      tclastralocal
      tclastylelocal
      tclasubstylelocal
      aum {
        totnetassets
        totnetassetsstd
        asofdate
      }
      shareclass {
        producttype
        shclname
        shclcode
        shclcurr
        prmryshclind
        incepdtstd
        perfincdt
        perfincdtstd
        shclfeestructr
        yields {
          stdsecyield30day
          stdsecyield30daywowaiver
          stdyieldasofdate30day
          curryield7day
          curryield7daywowaiver
          effctvyield7day
          effctvyield7daywowaiver
        }
        ratings {
          mscatg
          msrtngoverall
          msrtng3yr
          msrtng5yr
          msrtng10yr
          mnthendnooffnds3yr
          mnthendnooffnds5yr
          mnthendnooffnds10yr
          asofdate
        }
        identifiers {
          ticker
          bdrticker
          taid
          cusip
          isin
          sedol
          bloomberg
          fundbmticker
          intradaynav
          iopv
        }
        nav {
          navdate
          navvalue
          navchngvalue
          navchngpct
          mktpricevalue
          mktchngval
          mktchngpct
          ytdtotretatmktprice
          ytdtotretatnav
          distribrateatnav
          distribrateatpop
        }
        charges {
          sponsorgross
          sponsornet
          expratnet
          expratgross
          cdsc
          maxinitchrg
          waivertype
          waiverenddate
        }
        performance {
          month_end {
            avgannret1yr
            avgannret3yr
            avgannret5yr
            avgannret10yr
            avgannretactinc
            discrannualrollyear1
            discrannualrollyear2
            discrannualrollyear3
            discrannualrollyear4
            discrannualrollyear5
            cummret1mth
            cummret3mth
            cummret1yr
            cummret3yr
            cummret5yr
            cummret10yr
            cummretytd
            cummretactinc
            asofdate
            asofdatestd
            calcname
            calcnamestd
          }
          quarter_end {
            avgannret1yr
            avgannret3yr
            avgannret5yr
            avgannret10yr
            avgannretactinc
            discrannualrollyear1
            discrannualrollyear2
            discrannualrollyear3
            discrannualrollyear4
            discrannualrollyear5
            cummret1mth
            cummret3mth
            cummret1yr
            cummret3yr
            cummret5yr
            cummret10yr
            cummretytd
            cummretactinc
            asofdate
            asofdatestd
            calcname
            calcnamestd
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
